dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, did the police find your laptop?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, dɪd ðə pəˈliːs ˈfaɪnd jʊr ˈlæptɑːp?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but they're investigating. A detective came to my apartment this morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt, bʌt ðɛr ɪnˈvɛstɪɡeɪtɪŋ. ə dɪˈtɛktɪv ˈkeɪm tə maɪ əˈpɑːrtmənt ˈðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: He told me not to touch anything in the bedroom.
dialogue.reading: hiː ˈtoʊld miː ˈnɑːt tə ˈtʌtʃ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈbɛdruːm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: He wanted to look for fingerprints. He found some on the window.
dialogue.reading: hiː ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈlʊk fər ˈfɪŋɡərprɪnts. hiː ˈfaʊnd sʌm ɑːn ðə ˈwɪndoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. He also asked me to make a list of the missing things.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈæskt miː tə ˈmeɪk ə ˈlɪst əv ðə ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈθɪŋz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Do the police have a suspect?
dialogue.reading: duː ðə pəˈliːs ˈhæv ə ˈsʌspɛkt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Maybe. A neighbor saw a young man in a black jacket near the building.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ə ˈneɪbər ˈsɔː ə ˈjʌŋ ˈmæn ɪn ə ˈblæk ˈdʒækɪt ˈnɪr ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope they catch him soon.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðeɪ ˈkætʃ hɪm ˈsuːn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Me too. They asked me to call them if I remember something new.
dialogue.reading: miː ˈtuː. ðeɪ ˈæskt miː tə ˈkɔːl ðɛm ɪf aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈnuː.
